name: Open Items
rows: Fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 · USD · Equipment and leases audit workpapers
DRAFT FOR THE CPA · audit procedures · not an audit report · no opinion expressed

Westgate Equipment Rentals’s agreement WER-RA-3318 rents an identified crane for 36 months, non-cancellable, from September 1, 2025: a lease, not a rental. Operating (present value 51.8% of its value). Proposed: a right-of-use asset and a lease liability of $519,770.65 at June 30, 2026, and the lease disclosures.

The office lease’s new 60-month term is not recognized. Liability $1,580,613.31 and right-of-use asset $1,568,742.50 at June 30, 2026; the controller’s schedule left out the 3% increases and disclosed $1,484,173.90. Straight-line rent adds $11,870.81 to FY2026 rent expense.

EQ-2740 was sold on March 16, 2026 for $180,000.00, paid to the bank against the term loan. The register still carries it; the proceeds were credited to accumulated depreciation. Proposed: debit accumulated depreciation $622,449.28, credit cost $553,061.60 and a gain on sale $69,387.68.

Cascade Iron Equipment invoice CIE-26-30612 capitalized a $41,250.00 rebuild of EQ-3388 inside EQ-4416. Proposed: expense the rebuild and reduce EQ-4416’s cost; income overstated by $40,808.04 after its June depreciation.

EQ-3388 is depreciated over 60 months; the policy says 120 for its class and nothing documents a shorter life. At the policy life FY2026 depreciation is $23,343.96 more and accumulated depreciation $81,704.26 less. The CPA decides with the equipment manager.

EQ-4415, gps machine control and layout system, $84,150.00, bought June 8, 2026 with no signed capital expenditure request, against the policy. A control deficiency for the CPA to evaluate; the asset exists and is in use.
4 fully depreciated assets are still in daily use (EQ-3122, EQ-3388, EQ-3901, EQ-3990). The CPA considers whether the class lives are too short.
Materiality is proposed at $340,000.00, 0.5% of revenue, with performance materiality $255,000.00. The engagement partner sets the final amounts.
No management representation letter has been obtained. It should cover the completeness of the fixed asset register, leases and disposals.
These are draft workpapers and a draft findings memo for the engagement partner. They are not an audit report and give no opinion. Nothing has been signed, posted or sent.
